pr_title: roachtest: add delay after adding constraints.
pr_body:
Fixes: #105506.
Fixes: #105505.

Add a delay after adding the constraints before recommissioning the
node. This allows the constraints to propagate to all nodes and avoids
replicas being added back to the node.

Epic: none

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/105555)
After adding the 1 min sleep, the test passed 10 times in a row. I don't think this test was intended to test constraint propagation and it will be less flakey going forward with this change.

bors r=kvoli

TFTR. It takes ~30 sec until the constraints propagate to other nodes. I don't understand why it is taking this long, but I didn't want to leave this somewhat flakey by cutting it too close. I didn't look into where this is cached/sent from in detail.
